hooks.text: Neptune has completed only one orbit since humans found it.
Neptune takes 165 Earth years to circle the Sun.
We mapped Neptune before it finished a single solar orbit.

title: Why Neptune Only Finished One Orbit Since 1846
description: Humanity discovered Neptune in 1846, but the ice giant travels so far out that it takes 165 Earth years to circle the Sun. It completed its very first observed orbit in July 2011.
